token_map.policy: preserve existing visual tokens; no new canonical token is asserted from screenshot evidence
token_map.status_pills: preserve current semantic colors unless upstream status contract says otherwise

spacing_typography.rule: preserve current typography and spacing; this remediation does not assert unobserved design-system pixel tokens

density_rules: Preserve all nine visible filter criteria.
Preserve all ten visible table headers and row actions.
Do not reduce information density by silently dropping columns or filters.
risk_controls: Do not modify sidebar, topbar, company selector or other shell-locked elements.
Do not invent load, approval, payment, eligibility or legal semantics.
Pagination correction is derived only from the visible count 6 and visible page-size 25.
Horizontal overflow remains available whenever actual table width exceeds its container.
prompt_constraints: Use only the verified B2B-CARGA-001 visual artifact and governed profile/card/adapter context.
Do not use historical expected Golden outputs as authority.
Keep remediation limited to the screen-content delta.

remediation_actions.evidence_anchor: The frozen screen shows 6 cargas encontradas and 25 registros por página while pagination still exposes pages 1, 2, 3 plus a next control.
remediation_actions.decision: Set pagination state from the visible total-record count and page-size instead of exposing phantom pages.
remediation_actions.implementation_change: Set pagination to one active page when total_records=6 and page_size=25; disable or omit pages 2 and 3 and the next control until the derived page count exceeds one.
remediation_actions.acceptance_criteria: Pagination QA confirms that with 6 total records and page size 25 only page 1 is available; pages 2 and 3 and next are not actionable, and they reappear only when the derived page count requires them.

execution.desired_value: derive from ceil(total_records/page_size); for 6/25 => page 1 only, next unavailable

acceptance_check.expected: for total_records=6 and page_size=25: only page 1 available and next unavailable

remediation_actions.evidence_anchor: At the frozen 1600x1000 viewport all ten table headers including Acciones are visible while a horizontal scrollbar is still rendered below the six rows.
remediation_actions.decision: Hide table horizontal scroll chrome when the table does not overflow, while preserving horizontal overflow behavior when it is actually needed.
remediation_actions.implementation_change: Hide the table horizontal scroll control when scrollWidth is not greater than clientWidth; keep overflow auto so the scroll control remains available whenever the table exceeds its container.
remediation_actions.acceptance_criteria: Table horizontal scroll QA confirms the scrollbar is absent when all fields fit and becomes available without losing columns or actions whenever real horizontal overflow exists.

execution.desired_value: hidden when scrollWidth <= clientWidth; otherwise visible through overflow auto

acceptance_check.expected: hidden when no horizontal overflow; available when overflow exists

layout_precision.summary: The remediation preserves the observed desktop composition and limits precision claims to conditional overflow and visible state arithmetic.

visual_hierarchy.summary: The hierarchy keeps the results table dominant and treats scrollbar chrome as subordinate conditional UI rather than persistent content.

lf_system_fidelity.summary: The candidate preserves existing LF visual treatment, blocks shell changes and does not manufacture financial or approval semantics.

state_mapping.summary: Pagination and overflow states are explicitly derived from observable record-count, page-size and container-overflow conditions.

handoff_quality.summary: The Quality Pack handoff names the exact two remediation targets and requires independent semantic and deterministic validation before any downstream use.

handoff_to_next.instruction: Independently validate B2B-CARGA-PAGINATION-001 and B2B-CARGA-OVERFLOW-001 against the frozen visual artifact, UI Architect contract and LF governance. Do not infer a target verdict.
